title: Green Account (checking): Troubleshooting: declined transactions
summary: This document explains how to troubleshoot declined transactions on a Green Account (checking) by checking available balance vs. requested amount, pending authorizations, and decline notification details (“Yes”). It also covers merchant overcharge/recurring charge date issues and advises adding funds, retrying, and contacting the merchant with decline notice records if needed.
faqs: Why was my Green Account (checking) transaction declined?
How do I check whether my available balance covers the full amount requested?
Could a pending authorization be reducing my available balance and causing the decline?
What should I verify with the merchant if a decline keeps happening after I add funds?
How do recurring/subscription charges affect declines (e.g., on the charge date)?
Should I save the decline notification details/records, and where does the document suggest using them?
